reviewScope: Static adversarial review of synthetic fixture coverage, frozen UI semantics, unresolved policies, and progress consistency. This review does not accept T12 behavior.

coverage.uxFixtures: U01-U12 each appear exactly once; all 12 remain NOT_RUN.
coverage.supplementaryCases: 18 synthetic cases cover history/SavedItem identity, collection relations, editing/conflicts, filters, summary/detail boundaries, states, settings gates, cleanup, navigation, and privacy.
coverage.capacity: U08 uses limits.local.anonymousWebSessionBytes; U10 includes independent local/cache/outbox/version budget states while keeping T07/T06 accounting and result mappings OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.permissions: The U09 fixture covers automatic-input denial with usable clipboard/search and clipboard-write unavailability with cached search/read remaining available; UI copy/status mapping remains OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.responsiveAccessibility: Desktop 640 logical-pixel minimum and web 1024/768 CSS breakpoints are represented; exact narrow-panel transition remains OPEN_QUESTION. Keyboard reachability, visible 2px focus, reduced motion, and non-color-only status are planned; contrast and screen-reader thresholds remain OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.privacy: Canaries cover body, URL, title, source, image, key, token, and raw SQL parameters for the frozen 08 §6 telemetry/crash exclusion. User-visible error-content redaction remains OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.historyAndCollections: Saving history creates a distinct SavedItem and clearing history preserves it; history is read-only; collection deletion preserves saved content; create/rename and relation-only membership behavior are planned.
coverage.conflicts: Local/remote comparison, draft retention, and distinct SavedItem identity on save-as-copy are asserted; exact conflict return/merge mapping remains OPEN_QUESTION.

reviewFindings.detail: U08 references the configured session-byte field instead of shadowing its value. U10 now includes the version budget and retains T07/T06 accounting and enum gates.
U09 covers both automatic-input-unavailable and clipboard-write-unavailable capability combinations without asserting an unavailable operation succeeds.
Collection create/rename and relation-only changes are represented, and the save-as-copy conflict path checks for a new SavedItem identity.

The desktop 640 logical-pixel minimum is explicit. T29-gated bulk export is distinguished from U08's required explicit session-only plaintext export. The exact narrow-panel transition remains OPEN_QUESTION.

Canary assertions now match 08 §6 telemetry/crash exclusions, including source and unredacted SQL parameters. User-visible error wording/content redaction is left OPEN_QUESTION rather than treated as frozen.

notPerformed: Renderer/domain implementation, test, or browser execution
E2E, typecheck, build, or package commands
Live profile, database, account, service, or clipboard access
Responsive visual inspection or accessibility audit
limitations: All T12 behavior remains NOT_RUN; the dependencies are not accepted.
Exact user-visible error redaction/copy, storage accounting, conflict result mapping, responsive transition, and automated accessibility thresholds remain OPEN_QUESTION.
This static fixture review is not implementation validation or T12 acceptance.
